children: Netflix (NFLX, Financials) just picked up a Wall Street upgrade, but it came with an unusual catch.
Deutsche Bank upgraded the streaming company to Buy from Hold while cutting its price target to $95 from $100.
Even after the reduction, the new target implies roughly 37% upside from Netflix's latest price.
The bank also lowered its operating income and free cash flow estimates following Netflix's second-quarter results.
Still, Deutsche Bank sees enough longer-term opportunity to turn more positive on the stock, pointing to international growth and potential upside from artificial intelligence.

The call comes after Netflix shares have faced renewed questions over growth and competition in streaming. HSBC recently warned that the company is losing viewing share to YouTube, adding another concern for investors.
The Deutsche Bank upgrade suggests the recent pullback has changed the risk-reward calculation despite lower near-term financial estimates.
For investors, the next question is whether Netflix's international business and AI initiatives can deliver enough growth to support that more bullish view.

title: Netflix Just Got an Upgrade With an Unusual Catch
